 Current branches and delivery · 2026-11-11

 Entry Purpose 
 --- --- 
 main Published-version source and user documentation. 
 dev Current 3.10 development code: local firmware generation, static look storage, icon/name support and paired A7Look/DCP export. 
 Downloads The latest published Release is v3.0.3 . The prepared 3.10 packages have not been published as a Release. 
 Sony Imaging Cloud Community looks and sounds; the website uses the new blue-and-white cloud logo. 

 Keep the version at 3.10. Its Windows package contains only the default six
paired looks: Fujifilm Classic Negative (NC), Classic Chrome (CC), Nostalgic
Negative (NN), Astia (AS), Ricoh Positive Film (RP), and Negative Film (RN) .
The full 41 DCP/A7Look pairs , with their icon companions, are a separate
resource pack for cloud distribution; they are not bundled into Windows.

Windows EXE and Android APK builds with the shared cloud logo are prepared.
iOS has the updated Xcode project and icons; no installable IPA is available .
Earlier Release assets keep their original versions and contents.

The 3.10 fixed-look candidate and API file updates have passed their recorded
offline/component checks. API updates write persistent files; a completed write
requires the documented full power removal before checking the loaded look.
Immediate CP RAM reload and cache refresh are not part of the current flow.
Complete physical card updating, cold boot, video and long-term stability remain
unqualified. Pre-capture remains a separate research effort and is not enabled
in the ordinary generator.

The feature and USB instructions below describe the published line. Follow dev for the 3.10 implementation; this README update does not change main-branch runtime code or Release assets.

A desktop tool for the Sony A7C II (ILCE-7CM2) on firmware 2.01 . It adds FL2/FL3, custom Creative Looks, electronic shutter sound and Vertical Display, and can restore factory functions in one click.

 3.0 is the first release with a proper graphical interface. Driver setup, installation, cold reload and verification all happen with buttons in one window; no command line needed.

 Supported cameras

 [!IMPORTANT]
 This tool supports only the Sony A7C II (ILCE-7CM2) on firmware 2.01. It does not work on any other model, including the original A7C, the A7 IV, A7CR, A7R V, A6700 and A7 V. The app refuses to connect to them; please don't try.

For other models, these independent projects may help. They are not part of this project; check each one for its own scope and risks:

 --- --- ---

 A7CR injectiver/a7cr-creative-look-tools Research tools for FL2/FL3 and custom looks on firmware 2.01 (source only, no flashing command) 
 A7R V Hearts-Ace/sony-a7r5-custom-firmware FL2/FL3 firmware adaptation and RAW color research 
 A7 IV DavidBuchanan314/ILCE-7M4-RE Firmware reverse-engineering notes 
 A6700 xyzhangxin/sony-a6700-powerful Chinese guide for firmware 2.00: Pico wiring, Fastboot, backups and feature unlocks 
 A7 V No in-camera firmware project yet 751K/sony-a7m5-looks ports the A7 V Creative Looks to Lightroom/Capture One profiles (computer only; the camera is not modified) 

 Community: Telegram (recommended) · Discord
 Author: Xiaohongshu QAQLeonard（读研版） · Douyin LeonardZ (ID 90860261487 )

 [!IMPORTANT]
 This tool modifies programs and settings in the camera firmware. Read the whole step-by-step guide before you start. If the app reports an error, export a diagnostic bundle first. Do not keep retrying the write.

install.title: Download and requirements
install.html:
System Download Notes
Windows 10/11 x64 A7C2Tools-Windows-x64.zip from Releases Extract the whole archive and run A7C2Tools.exe. Keep the _internal and Profiles folders next to it; don't copy the EXE out on its own. No Python install needed.
macOS 14+ (Apple Silicon) A7C2Tools-macOS-arm64.dmg from Releases Drag the app into Applications. It isn't signed by a developer, so allow it once under System Settings → Privacy & Security. No Intel build. USB on a real Mac has not been verified yet.

Both packages include 15 paired DCP and .a7look files (11 Fujifilm, 4 Ricoh color). The two files for each look share the same name and sit side by side:

  • Windows: in the Profiles folder next to the EXE.
  • macOS: inside the app. Open them with 打开内置 DCP／A7Look 配对库 (Open paired DCP/A7Look library) on the Custom Creative Looks page.

The .a7look goes into the camera; the matching .dcp is for RAW development in Lightroom.

Camera: ILCE-7CM2 on firmware 2.01. No other model or firmware version is supported.

usage.title: Using each feature on its own
usage.html:
Every write follows the same pattern: write → full readback → dialog asking for a cold reload. Once Step 1 is done, each page can be used on its own.

FL2 / FL3
  • 启用／重新启用 FL2 / FL3 (Enable / re-enable): cold-reload after the write. If you can select them on the camera, you're done; no need to reconnect and verify.
  • 从列表移除 FL2 / FL3，保留自定义外观 (Remove from list, keep custom looks): hides the menu entries only. Shared code used by custom looks stays, so you can enable them again later.
  • Switch the camera to ST before removing them.
Custom Creative Looks
  1. Click + 添加操作项 (Add operation) once for each slot you want to change:
    • 写入 A7Look (Write A7Look): choose a .a7look file and, optionally, the name shown on the camera (empty uses the name stored in the file).
    • 恢复 ST 默认 (Restore ST): resets the slot to ST. New items default to this.
  2. Click 查看并应用这 N 项更改 (Review and apply N changes), check the list and confirm. All listed slots are written in one go; other slots are left alone.
  3. Cold-reload and it's ready to use. No separate verification needed.

[!NOTE] Custom looks are written with ST as their base look. Just select the custom slot on the camera; you don't need to switch the Creative Look to ST. But don't change that custom slot's base look to anything other than ST in the camera menu, or the custom look may not apply or the colors may be wrong; switching it back to ST fixes it. The camera does not lock this option.

Tools on the same page:

  • 打开内置 DCP／A7Look 配对库 (Open paired DCP/A7Look library): 15 pairs (11 Fujifilm, 4 Ricoh); each DCP sits next to its .a7look with the same name.
  • 从 DCP／LUT 生成 A7Look… (Generate A7Look from DCP/LUT): offline conversion; doesn't connect to the camera.
    • A CUBE must take Sony ST / sRGB input and output sRGB. Log LUTs such as S-Log3 can't be used directly; see LUT formats and color spaces.
    • A DCP is parsed and fitted by the app itself; Lightroom isn't needed.
  • 安装 LrC 自动识别插件… (Install Lightroom plugin): after installing, enable it once in Lightroom's Plug-in Manager. From then on, when you import RAW files it applies the DCP for the slot each shot used. It never alters the RAW data itself.
Electronic shutter sound
  1. 开启电子快门声 (Turn on shutter sound): turns on Sony's native electronic shutter sound. Cold-reload after the write.
  2. Choose an audio or video file, set the start and length (0.01–2 s), then click 转换所选片段 (Convert selected clip). This runs on the computer only.
  3. Optionally adjust the volume with −3 dB / +3 dB / 还原转换时音量 (reset to converted volume).
  4. Click 保存当前自定义声音 (Save current custom sound) and cold-reload after the write.
  5. 相机内临时试听 (Temporary in-camera audition) is optional. While auditioning, keep the camera on, unplug USB and take a test shot; reconnect and save if you like it.
  6. To go back to the original sound, click 恢复原厂音效 (Restore factory sound).
Vertical Display

[!NOTE] The vertical menu frames are being rewritten. This section will be updated when that work is finished.

  • 启用竖屏显示 (Enable Vertical Display): saves the switch. After a cold reload, shooting information and icons rotate when you hold the camera vertically.
  • 关闭竖屏显示 (Disable Vertical Display): turns it off first, then reverts the related changes.
  • Both buttons are safe to click again; nothing is rewritten when the state already matches.
Restore factory functions

See Step 2. The advanced section also offers two other ways to restore:

  • Import a complete stock BODYDATA.DAT and restore from it.
  • Return to an earlier state from an old body backup (one made by older FL23 or lut.py versions).
